WITH months AS ( -- 生成过去12个月的时间段 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (t.n-1) MONTH), '%Y-%m') AS month FROM (SELECT 1 AS n UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9 UNION SELECT 10 UNION SELECT 11 UNION SELECT 12) t ), followup_counts AS ( -- 统计每个月的跟进数量 SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.interview_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM crm_client_interview f WHERE f.interview_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND f.interview_time < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY month ) -- 使用 LEFT JOIN 确保所有月份都显示，即使没有数据 SELECT m.month, COALESCE(f.count, 0) AS count FROM months m LEFT JOIN followup_counts f ON m.month = f.month ORDER BY m.month;
